purpose: End-to-end multi-framework repo auditing, live/Firecrawl capture, asset localization, Astro v7 scaffolding, Visual Digital Twin parity checks, build verification, and a source-cited knowledge vault.

discovery.setup: Python 3.11+ and Node.js 22.23.4+ (LTS 24.15.0 recommended). Optional Playwright runtime for `twin`. Offline doctor, source-audit, ingest/scaffold preview, verify-build, twin-diff, and docs-lookup require no credentials.
discovery.not_for: Provisioning cloud servers, reverse proxies, or DNS records; executing untrusted astro.config.mjs files during read-only inspection.
examples: Convert my WordPress export or static HTML pages to an Astro v7 site and verify parity
Check why my Astro v7 build broke client scripts, styles, trailing slashes, or content collections
Audit an existing site before migrating to Astro and verify the built dist folder afterward
Attach the Astro v7 knowledge pack to my Empire vault

scope: Portable Python and Node CLI for Astro v7 readiness, multi-framework repository auditing (Next.js, Nuxt, Gatsby, Vite/CRA, Docusaurus, Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, SvelteKit), live HTTP/Firecrawl capture, two-pass asset localization (vendor-assets), preview-first clone/editorial scaffolding (scaffold/ingest), post-build dist/ parity verification (verify-build), Playwright Visual Digital Twin diffing (twin/twin-diff), pinned withastro/docs lookup, and attachable Empire knowledge pack.
